timeline.evidenceText: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.
Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, Yahweh has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah.

definitions.full: H4762. Mareshah מָרֵשָׁה and ( Josh 15:44 ) מָרֵאשָׁה proper name, of a location (etymology dubious) in (the Shephelah of) Judah, Micah 1:15 (where named with אַכְזִיבּ etc.), Josh 15:44 ( id. ), compare 2Chr 11:8 ; 14:8 ; 14:9 ; 20:37 ; so apparently (as proper name, masculine in Geneal. scheme) 1Chr 2:42 ; 4:21 . — compare 2Macc 12:35 ( Μαρισα ), 1 Macc 5:66 (read Μαρισα for Σαμαρια , compare Var. Apocrypha). — Joseph Ant. xii. 8 , 6 ( Μαρισσα ). ᵐ5 A Josh 15:44 Μαρησὰ ᵐ5 L βαρσηα ; ᵐ5 1Chr 2:42 Μαρἑἰσα ᵐ5 L Μαρησα , etc. Probably = modern Mer¹sh 1mile South of Beit Jibrin (Eleutheropolis), compare Rob BR ii. 31 Be 2:42 GASm Geogr. 233 (who identify with ( גַּת ) מוֺרֶשֶׁת Micah 1:14 q. v. below ירשׁ above, but see Lag Ono.n. 139, 141, 279, 282 ) Buhl Geogr. 192 . מִרְשַׁ֫עַת see מֹרַשְׁתִּי רשׁע see ירשׁ . מָרֵשָׁה מָרֵאשָׁה, proper name, of a location .
